The structure of Mg14Ti2Co2 (Mg7TiCo) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 28 atoms per unit cell distributed over nine independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co and Ti each adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 Mg neighbors, while Mg centers exhibit 12- and 14-neighbor environments, including Mg–Co and Mg–Ti contacts. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 28 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between 12-vertex Mg polyhedra, and edge-sharing between Co- and Mg-centered 12-vertex polyhedra.
